problem_statement: When a Dnssd host registration is carried over the Spinel property codec, the host's address list is not decoded according to its declared address count. If the host advertises zero addresses, decoding fails instead of leaving the address list empty; if it advertises more than one address, the codec only consumes the first address and misreads the trailing fields, corrupting the request id and callback. A malformed or inconsistent address count is also not rejected. The codec must decode exactly the number of addresses that were encoded: an empty list yields a null address pointer and zero count, a multi-address host yields all addresses, and an inconsistent count is reported as a parse error.
oracle_note: observed by validate_instance.py (fail before, pass after the fix); the unit oracle is per executable, so check attribution of the cases to the PR's change
